2022 county recap sheets checked and the name not found in the 2026 contest's district: Barren (Magistrate 4th: Coomer, Eaton), Boyle (Magistrate 1st: Tom V. Ellis, a different given name, left out), Caldwell (Jailer: Harper, Pettit), Hopkins (Magistrate 5th: Hudson, Parrish), Daviess, Floyd, Ohio; 2022 and 2024 city and school contests in Boyd (Ashland), Campbell (Fort Thomas), Bullitt (Mount Washington, Shepherdsville) and Christian (school district 5) without these names.
Recap sheets for Knox, Letcher, Mason, McCreary, Montgomery, Pike, Russell, Todd and Wayne are image layers that could not be read here; those candidates are blank, not cleared.
Ginny Mulvey-Woolridge ran in House District 46 in 2022; nothing ties Brad Woolridge to that run, so nothing is recorded for him.

Verifier (2026-10-03): every url re-opened. The six county recap PDFs were read as text: Pryor (REP) and Woosley (REP) sole candidates in every precinct of their contests, Butcher (DEM) sole candidate for Constable 5th, Patrick sole candidate for Board of Education 1st; LaGrange council totals summed across precincts put Laura Taylor first of the field in 2022 and third of sixteen in 2024 (a different Jason Taylor also ran in 2024). The Secretary of State's statewide PDF shows SIZEMORE 18,406 and STEELE 8,463 for 17th District, 2nd Division. The Court of Justice page and the General Assembly profile state what is recorded.
